lead.tldr: Earlybird‑AVP defence fund €500m shows rising VC appetite for security tech, may drive consolidation in European defence crypto • Anchorage gets first US national bank charter, opening regulated banking lane for crypto firms, likely accelerating institutional adoption • Polymarket insider betting on US Iran strike triggers DEATH BETS Act, signaling regulatory crackdown on war‑related prediction markets • MoonPay Trade platform gives banks DeFi access across 200+ chains, positioning fintechs for tokenized‑asset services • Variational's $50m Series A targets RWA perpetuals, could become DeFi's largest contract class, attracting institutional capital • AI agents settled $73m USDC, indicating early machine‑to‑machine crypto payments, major players building infrastructure for trillion‑dollar future

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, Europe’s defence‑focused €500 m fund launch, Anchorage’s historic U.S. bank charter, and MoonPay’s cross‑chain platform for banks signal a surge in security‑aware infrastructure. Meanwhile AI agents are already settling crypto payments, hinting at massive future commerce.

top_signals.title: Earlybird raising €500m defence fund with French investor AVP, sources say
top_signals.summary: Berlin‑based venture capital firm Earlybird is partnering with French investor AVP to create a defence‑focused fund. The vehicle is targeting €500 million in capital, a size that is uncommon for European venture capital partnerships. The fund will seek to invest in security and defence technologies, offering institutional investors exposure to a growing sector.

top_signals.title: Anchorage and the Charter Wars with Nathan McCauley
top_signals.summary: Anchorage secured the first U.S. national bank charter for a crypto firm after a prolonged regulatory battle. The dispute, often framed as the “Charter Wars,” involved senior regulator Nathan McCauley. The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency is now reopening its banking lane, inviting additional crypto firms to seek similar charters. Industry observers view the approval as a catalyst that could accelerate the next phase of crypto adoption among institutional investors.

top_signals.title: A crypto betting platform may have leaked U.S. military secrets before a surprise attack on Iran, experts warn
top_signals.summary: Bubblemaps investigators found 80 highly accurate bets on Polymarket that predicted U.S. military actions against Iran, raising concerns of insider trading that could have exposed U.S. war plans. The potential leak has prompted congressional lawmakers to advance the DEATH BETS Act, which would prohibit prediction contracts tied to armed conflict. Polymarket responded by announcing the implementation of Chainalysis‑backed oversight to monitor future markets.

top_signals.title: MoonPay expands into tokenized assets and DeFi markets with new platform for banks
top_signals.summary: MoonPay has launched MoonPay Trade, a cross‑chain platform that provides banks and fintech firms with direct access to tokenized assets, decentralized finance protocols and stablecoin liquidity. The platform operates across more than 200 blockchains and is built on the Decent.xyz infrastructure that MoonPay recently acquired for a high eight‑figure amount. Leadership of the service is headed by former acting CFTC Chair Caroline Pham, underscoring regulatory expertise as the offering targets institutional participants seeking exposure to emerging digital asset markets.

top_signals.title: KKR backs UK’s newest unicorn in $80m round
top_signals.summary: London‑based beauty and wellness SaaS startup Fresha has raised $80 million from private‑equity firm KKR, taking its valuation above $1 billion and granting it unicorn status. The capital will be deployed to accelerate international expansion and to advance AI‑driven product development across its platform. Fresha currently serves more than 130 k businesses and processes over $15 billion in annual gross merchandise volume, highlighting its scale in the sector.

top_signals.title: Satoshi’s 1.1M bitcoin and millions more can be saved from quantum attack, says expert
top_signals.summary: An expert says that the 1.1 million bitcoins attributed to Satoshi Nakamoto and millions of other dormant assets could be protected from a potential quantum computing attack. AmericanFortress has introduced a patent‑pending post‑quantum signature scheme that would be deployed through a backward‑compatible soft fork to secure dormant Bitcoin and other major chain holdings. Backed by an $8 million seed round the protocol plans to freeze vulnerable pre‑BIP32 addresses until governance determines their disposition, a move that could safeguard more than $400 billion in crypto value.

top_signals.title: SpaceX IPO: Orbital Data Centers Emerge as a Central Component of Musk's Grand Vision
top_signals.summary: SpaceX’s IPO filing reveals a plan to construct orbital data centers designed to support frontier AI models. The filing estimates that the venture could address a $22.7 trillion enterprise market, positioning the company to capture significant AI infrastructure revenue. Although the concept remains speculative and is not expected to launch until 2028, it signals SpaceX’s intent to become a major player in the emerging space‑based computing ecosystem.

top_signals.title: AI agents are starting to pay with crypto as Coinbase, Stripe and Visa want in, Keyrock report says
top_signals.summary: A Keyrock report finds that AI agents have already settled more than $73 million in USDC across 176 million blockchain transactions. The activity is prompting leading fintech and payments firms including Coinbase, Stripe, Google and Visa to develop infrastructure for machine‑to‑machine crypto payments. Although the current volume is small relative to traditional finance, the report highlights the strategic importance of integrating automated crypto settlement for institutional portfolios. Industry forecasts anticipate that AI‑driven commerce could reach trillions of dollars by the end of the decade, underscoring a long‑term growth opportunity.

top_signals.title: HYPE Hits All-Time High Above $62 as ETF Flows Grow on Bankless
top_signals.summary: The HYPE token has climbed to a new all‑time high above $62. The price surge is linked to strong inflows into U.S. spot HYPE exchange‑traded funds that have drawn roughly $54 million in their first week. This level of capital attraction signals growing institutional appetite for the asset class. Presto Research notes that institutional interest in HYPE ETFs is already exceeding the early accumulation patterns observed for Bitcoin ETFs.

top_signals.title: Blockchain.com files with SEC for U.S. IPO
top_signals.summary: Blockchain.com has confidentially submitted an S‑1 registration statement to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to assess a potential initial public offering. The filing signals the company's intention to transition from a private crypto‑focused platform to a publicly traded entity. This initiative occurs amid a slowdown in cryptocurrency sector IPOs, reflecting broader market weakness. Recent crypto listings have underperformed, prompting investors to scrutinize new offerings more closely.

top_signals.title: Variational predicts RWA perpetuals will soon be the biggest contract class in DeFi
top_signals.summary: Variational is an on‑chain derivatives protocol that has raised a $50 million Series A financing round. The round was led by Dragonfly and included participation from Bain Capital Crypto and Coinbase Ventures. The funding will be used to launch perpetual futures contracts tied to real‑world assets such as gold, silver, copper and WTI crude oil. Variational expects these RWA perpetuals to become the largest contract class in the decentralized finance ecosystem, expanding exposure to commodity markets for institutional participants.

top_signals.title: Ethereum (ETH) news: The blockchain’s identity crisis is deepening after high-profile 'brain drain' frustrates community
top_signals.summary: Recent high‑profile departures from the Ethereum Foundation have raised concerns about the organization’s alignment with the network’s economic incentives. Critics, including former researcher Dankrad Feist, contend that the Foundation’s limited funding and weak accountability mechanisms could undermine the platform’s competitive position. The perceived “brain drain” highlights an identity crisis for Ethereum as it struggles to retain top talent and maintain coherent governance. Institutional investors are watching these governance challenges because they could affect the long‑term stability and value proposition of ETH as a core infrastructure asset.

linkedin_post: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, Europe’s venture ecosystem is seeing a convergence of security, finance and crypto that is reshaping how we think about risk and opportunity. Earlybird’s recent partnership with French investor AVP to launch a €500 million defence fund is a clear signal that institutional capital is ready to back the next generation of security technologies. The size of the vehicle is rare for a European partnership and it will give investors exposure to a sector that traditionally sits behind closed doors. Across the Atlantic, Anchorage’s hard‑won victory in the so‑called Charter Wars shows that regulators can become allies when crypto firms demonstrate sound governance. The approval of the first U.S. national bank charter for a crypto company, after senior regulator Nathan McCauley’s involvement, opens a banking lane that many firms are now eager to explore. This milestone could accelerate institutional adoption of crypto‑based financial services. At the same time, the Polymarket episode reminds us that the power of prediction markets must be balanced with responsibility. Investigators uncovered dozens of accurate bets on U.S. military actions against Iran, prompting the DEATH BETS Act and a new Chainalysis‑backed oversight framework. It is a stark reminder that transparency and compliance are non‑negotiable as we build the future. How will you navigate the tension between rapid innovation and the need for robust safeguards in this evolving landscape? #Web3 #Crypto #Blockchain #CryptoVC
